method: Current first-party parish directories are reconciled body by body. Search engines, maps, historical projects, and general directories are discovery sources only. This tranche publishes two complete live rosters while every other canonical Canadian jurisdiction remains explicitly queued for its own official-source pass.

candidates.name: Archdiocese of Canada of the Orthodox Church in America
candidates.status: queued for exact current first-party body reconciliation
candidates.reason: The official communities directory exposes a current roster with clergy and community details. It requires a separate body-level normalization pass before publication.

candidates.name: Romanian Episcopate and Romanian Orthodox Vicariate of Canada
candidates.status: queued for exact current first-party body reconciliation
candidates.reason: The current official vicariate page names the three Canadian deaneries and their parish bodies with public contacts. It remains separate from the Romanian Patriarchate structure.

candidates.name: Antiochian Diocese of Ottawa, Eastern Canada and Upstate New York
candidates.status: queued for exact current first-party body reconciliation
candidates.reason: The official Canadian episcopal conference and the official North American jurisdiction directory establish this canonical structure. Its Canadian parish roster must be separated from its United States bodies.

candidates.name: Moscow Patriarchal Parishes in Canada and the ROCOR Canadian Diocese
candidates.reason: The official jurisdiction directories distinguish the Moscow Patriarchal Parishes from ROCOR. Their current Canadian bodies must be reconciled without collapsing the two structures.

candidates.name: Serbian Orthodox Diocese of Canada
candidates.status: queued for exact current first-party body reconciliation
candidates.reason: The official Serbian North American site publishes the Canadian diocese and its bodies. Each current parish, monastery, and mission still requires normalization and contact provenance.

candidates.name: Romanian Patriarchate, Bulgarian, Albanian, Carpatho-Russian, Georgian, and Macedonian Canadian bodies
candidates.reason: The official North American jurisdiction directory identifies these canonical authorities separately. Their Canadian bodies must be verified against each competent Church and kept distinct from similarly named OCA or Constantinople structures.

reconciliation.result: The Ukrainian directory publishes two records for Saint Michael Parish in Candiac with the same institutional phone. The record carrying the exact street address is retained as the single physical body. The duplicate page remains cited here rather than creating two churches.

reconciliation.issue: Ukrainian eparchy and region link order
reconciliation.result: The official parish pages do not print eparchy and region links in a single consistent order. Hierarchy was derived from the official eparchy URL depth and reconciled into three eparchies and forty regions before publication.
A parish site is attached only when the official roster prints that site for the body. The Greek and Ukrainian directory pages remain provenance sources and are not relabeled as body-owned sites.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The complete live official parish page yields seventy-five named bodies. Published phones and body-owned sites are retained only where the Archdiocese prints them.

All twelve pages of the current official parish directory yield two hundred forty-two records. One same-body duplicate is reconciled, leaving two hundred forty-one parish bodies beneath three eparchies and forty official regions.

The official Canadian conference and North American jurisdiction directories establish the remaining authorities. They are retained as named queues rather than inferred from maps, ethnicity, or historical affiliation.

limitations.result: This is a large safe tranche, not a claim that Canada is complete. Only the two fully reconciled official rosters are published in this module. Every remaining jurisdiction is still queued above.

A map pin, review page, historical project, or general directory does not prove current canonical affiliation or institutional status. Such discoveries require a current competent Church citation before publication.
Only public institutional contact data printed by an official Church roster is attached. Clergy names are not reproduced as directory bodies and private contact assumptions are not made.
